scientific_integrity: Proof supplies all-group combinatorial equivalence; finite verification corroborates eight cases and an exact 5-by-5 parallel-edge face census; integral 3-torsion of the ordinary 5-by-5 chessboard is an explicitly cited prior theorem.
scientific_limitations: Complete bipartite, shore-preserving finite-group actions only; noncanonical labeling of fixed-space multigraph blocks; torsion corollary gives a split summand, not complete homology. Publication priority requires independent review.
title: A normalizer-weighted chessboard model for geometric matching-complex fixed spaces
